name: Nina Handel
source:
The fourth daughter of the Handels who majors in theology at school. She spends most of her time studying with the archbishop at the altar and even occasionally works as a priest. 

She is not as popular as her brothers and sisters and hates the lying atmosphere back at home. However, she's pretty outgoing in front of Mona and Rose and relies on Mona quite a lot.

Nina's father passed away when she was still young. Although her mother is quite strict with her, she still has a lot of respect for her.

[Edited from in-game bio]
